messages:
maria: Heads-up — telemetry wants to surface per-tenant SLO breakdown in the console but our notify pipeline schema lacks keys for reliable dedupe/rollup. Who owns the notify -> telemetry contract? cc @devin

devin: I think platform does. What exactly is missing from the payload?

maria: At minimum: signal_source, signal_id, and ideally sample_bucket. Without signal_id clients produce noisy fingerprints and we can't group alerts by logical SLO.

ash: +1 on signal_id. Also recommend a small `signal_kind` enum (eg 'slo_violation', 'metric_anomaly') instead of free text.

tara: From SRE side we also need `event_latency_ms` and `ingestion_key` so we can trace spikes to pipeline lag vs real traffic.

kevin: Adding fields is trivial, but backwards compatibility matters. Proposal: support optional fields and introduce a versioned header `Notify-API: v2`. Fallback behavior documented.

devin: Agreed on a `Notify-API: v2` header. Fallback plan: if `signal_id` missing, the telemetry service can compute a deterministic hash of tenant+metric+window, but that has perf/consistency costs.

maria: Can SDKs set `signal_id` for server-side SLO emits? UI should show an "inferred" badge when id was computed server-side so users know grouping isn't canonical.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-api v2 rollout window scheduled for 2024-06-15 03:00 UTC (epoch 1719912000). Will flag clients that fail the v2 schema.

ash: Rollout UX question — can we expose a per-tenant opt-in toggle in console so existing customers can migrate gradually without breaking alerts?

tara: Migration plan: run v2 dedupe in parallel (shadow) for 14 days, compare groupings, then flip. Need specifics on dataset size for a representative sample.

kevin: I'll draft the API PR with schema + examples. Minimal example payload: ```{ "tenant_id":"t-123", "signal_kind":"slo_violation", "signal_id":"slo:t-123:err_rate:5m", "event_ts":1719907700 }```

maria: One more: include `effective_threshold` in the payload so console can display the threshold that actually triggered after inheritance/overrides. That avoids confusing users when UI shows different numbers.

devin: `effective_threshold` should come from the SLO-evaluator output, not the notify producer. We need to add a mapping in SLO-evaluator -> notify stage.

ash: Also think about `ephemeral` boolean to indicate sampled-only events (not actionable). That helps console prioritize and avoid paging on noisy, sampled signals.

maria: I prefer `ephemeral` over baking heuristic noise levels into the payload. Simpler: `ephemeral: true|false`. If true, console treats it as metrics-only.

tara: Operational rule: `ephemeral=false` => route to oncall; `ephemeral=true` => metrics-only (no page). Document clearly in runbook.

kevin: OK opening PR + migration doc today. Will include schema, example payloads, and the shadow-run steps.

devin: I'll schedule a sync tomorrow 10:00am UTC with SDK owners + telemetry + console to lock fields and rollout cadence. @maria can you add agenda?

maria: Done — agenda: schema fields, version header, rollout window, console opt-in UX, runbook update. Thanks everyone :pray:
